# SakuraCord v0.1.7
# SakuraCord v0.1.7 for macOS 26 (unofficial port)
The official SakuraCord v0.1.7, ported to build and run on macOS 26.5 (Xcode 26.6 / Swift 6.3).
## Highlights from upstream v0.1.7
- Discord Activities like Wordle from calls, text channels and DMs - Friends view with Online, All, Pending and Add Friend, plus Message Requests - Discord's Favorites server, synced both ways - In-place message editing with live Markdown previews - Voice messages with waveforms, seeking and playback speed - Scheduled and @silent messages, and an @time picker for Discord timestamps - Create Thread from any message, and a rebuilt forum browser - Apply to Join for servers that review new members - File cards with Quick Look previews, and inline video and audio - Role icons and gradient role colours - Profile bios with Markdown, custom emoji and live timestamps - `:name:` emoji shortcodes, and embeds at Discord’s own sizes - Default and Bubbles message styles, and a message font size setting - Better unread tracking, drafts that stay put, and parallel uploads - Removed Show hidden channels
## Port additions
- **Rich Presence** (PR #528 by DinanathDash): shows what you're playing in Spotify or Apple Music, and activity from apps that use Discord's RPC. macOS will ask once for permission to read Music and Spotify. - Fixed missing icons (GIF button, Discord and GitHub symbols, About logo and badges) - Fixed glitchy, rainbow-smeared side panels on macOS 26 - Fixed the solid toolbar, which is now transparent like the rest of the window - Updates still use Sparkle 2.9.6
**Upstream changelog:** https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6...v0.1.7
